context: Request: the most recent closed M&A deal that had disclosure schedules, to use as a template. Rubric: 1006-00008 (Crestline Packaging outpatient-clinic bolt-on; APA signed June 16 2025, closed August 15 2025) and its disclosure-schedules.docx, plus a precision criterion. Rubric titles carry no matter numbers, so the logs have no surfacing markers; surfacing was checked in the raw traces.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a files-with-matches grep for request words (about 250 files).

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over file paths for deal and schedule words, first 200 hits only.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads schedules, agreements, an email and a certificate from three matters on that list.
Lists the files of one candidate matter.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads short openings of agreements, certificates and schedules from six matters to compare dates.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads the draft agreement, closing certificates, opinion letter, checklist and schedules of the matter it picked.
Writes one matter as the most recent closed deal, with two others as comparators.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its file-name search was cut at 200 lines and never reached the latest deal; it picked the latest among the matters it saw.

first_error.stage: Search file names for request keywords
first_error.why: Its file-name search was cut at 200 lines before reaching the matter it needed, and it never ran an uncapped search for schedule documents.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads agreements, a checklist, an email and an issues list of the two matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Content grep inside one of those matters with a non-recursive glob; returns nothing.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads later sections of that matter's agreement, its checklist and memo, plus one document of the other matter.
Writes the listing-top matter as the most recent closed deal and says no standalone schedules exist.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Search within a candidate matter's files → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Never searched the store; named the closed deal at the top of the listing.

first_error.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
first_error.why: It chose what to read from the two matters at the top of a capped listing without any store-wide search, so no other deal ever surfaced.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a files-with-matches grep for request words (about 250 files).

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: A schedule-name glob (capped at 100 files) and a deal-folder glob, alongside reads of three emails of a candidate from the grep list (labelled by the search intent).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads agreements, schedules, emails and a certificate of three candidates and lists files of two of them; one guessed path does not exist.
Writes one matter as the most recent closed deal with schedules, plus an older comparator.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its schedule-name glob listed the latest deal's schedules, but it opened only three other matters and named one of them.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: The schedule-name glob just before listed the matter's schedules file, but the three candidates it chose to open left that matter out and it never checked its date.

divergence: All three runs named an older deal. T0's capped file-name search never reached the latest deal (search miss); T1 read only the two matters at the top of the listing (partial listing as corpus); T2's schedule-name glob listed the latest deal's schedules but it opened three other matters (surfaced, never opened).
